fusions.name: Plate Peeler
fusions.desc: Catches a plate on the tines and wrenches, dealing 4 damage and leaving the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gap in the Plate
fusions.desc: Drives the tines through a gap in the plate, dealing 26 damage that ignores armour and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. A boss or elite takes a further 5% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Bristling Pauldrons
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Scrap Collector
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
